name: Lone Actor and Small-Value Terrorist Funding
description: Individuals or very small cells fund attacks, travel or equipment from personal income, savings, consumer credit or small gifts, producing low-value activity that blends into normal retail banking. Detection relies on combinations of weak signals and on external intelligence rather than any single threshold.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
FATF, Ethnically or Racially Motivated Terrorism Financing (2021)

exposure.rationale: Low-value retail activity: credit, asset liquidation and cash.

indicators.name: Rapid consumer credit drawdown with no stated purpose
indicators.canon: Rapid consumer credit drawdown with no stated purpose
indicators.desc: Customer takes several unsecured loans, credit cards or overdraft limits in a short window and withdraws or transfers the proceeds quickly, then ceases repayment.
indicators.ctx: Customer takes several unsecured loans, credit cards or overdraft limits in a short window and withdraws or transfers the proceeds quickly, then ceases repayment.
indicators.fp: Common in financial distress, gambling or fraud victimisation; most such patterns are not terrorism related.

indicators.name: Sale of assets and liquidation of savings followed by withdrawal
indicators.canon: Sudden liquidation of savings or assets
indicators.desc: Savings, investments or assets are sold abruptly, followed by withdrawal or transfer.
indicators.ctx: Customer liquidates property, vehicle or investments and withdraws cash or moves funds abroad without an evident life event.
indicators.fp: Relocation, divorce, bereavement and business downturn are frequent legitimate drivers.

indicators.name: Purchases consistent with attack preparation reported by authorities
indicators.canon: Purchases consistent with attack preparation reported by authorities
indicators.desc: Spending on items or services that match typologies shared by law enforcement or public-private partnerships, such as particular combinations of retail goods, vehicle hire and reconnaissance-type travel.
indicators.ctx: Spending on items or services that match typologies shared by law enforcement or public-private partnerships, such as particular combinations of retail goods, vehicle hire and reconnaissance-type travel.
indicators.fp: Individual purchases are lawful; only the combination, timing and external intel make it meaningful.

indicators.name: Adverse media or open-source concern about extremist engagement
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Customer is named in credible reporting or intelligence-led alerts for extremist advocacy, associations or prior convictions linked to violence.
indicators.fp: Media can be wrong, outdated or about a namesake; association alone is not proof of funding intent.

indicators.name: Sudden change in financial behaviour and lifestyle
indicators.canon: Sudden change in financial behaviour and lifestyle
indicators.desc: Customer shifts from stable spending to minimal discretionary spend, repeated cash withdrawals, closing of long-standing products or giving away assets.
indicators.ctx: Customer shifts from stable spending to minimal discretionary spend, repeated cash withdrawals, closing of long-standing products or giving away assets.
indicators.fp: Religious observance, health events, job loss or emigration plans can look identical.

indicators.name: Small transfers to or from a person on a watch or investigative list
indicators.canon: Dealings with known facilitators or persons on investigative watch lists
indicators.desc: Customer transacts, including in small amounts, with persons identified in public or law-enforcement material as facilitators or subjects of prior reports.
indicators.ctx: Low-value payments with parties linked to previously reported subjects or to persons arrested in connection with violent extremism.
indicators.fp: Family, employment or community connections to a subject can be innocent.

indicators.name: Travel and accommodation spending to conflict-adjacent regions
indicators.canon: Travel and accommodation spending to conflict-adjacent regions
indicators.desc: Spending on flights, border-area hotels or overland transport near conflict zones inconsistent with known occupation or history.
indicators.ctx: Spending on flights, border-area hotels or overland transport near conflict zones inconsistent with known occupation or history.
indicators.fp: Tourism, aid work, journalism and family visits explain most such spending.

indicators.name: Use of multiple accounts or prepaid products to stay below thresholds
indicators.canon: Use of multiple accounts or prepaid products to stay below thresholds
indicators.desc: Funds spread across several accounts, prepaid cards or wallets at the same or different providers, each carrying small balances before consolidated cash-out.
indicators.ctx: Funds spread across several accounts, prepaid cards or wallets at the same or different providers, each carrying small balances before consolidated cash-out.
indicators.fp: Students, migrants and unbanked users frequently use multiple small products.
